label: gl-vk-offscreen-scratch-pool, after: the scRGB offscreen let go is freed, by a scratch purge after the next frame is submitted
kind: real-window Vulkan probes, not a perf-suite capture (the suite never builds SkiaVulkanRenderSurface)
machine: SPELDATOR, i7-14700K, RTX 4080 driver 610.62, Windows 11 26200, HDR display 4K at 150%, 120 Hz
configuration: Release, HULTUI_A11Y=0, SDL_WINDOW_ACTIVATE_WHEN_SHOWN=0, HULTUI_VULKAN_F16=1, HULTUI_VULKAN_PRESENT=mailbox, P-cores, idle-gated before every run, before and after alternated (ABBA)

purgeAtTheResizeInstead.note: first version: purge inside ReleaseOffscreen, before the next frame; same memory, more resources made again, no faster

results.purgeCallMs: 0.16-0.73 per resize (HULTUI_STARTUP trace), larger when a texture over 10 MB is freed

validation.layers: VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation 1.4.357, core + synchronisation (VK_LAYER_VALIDATE_SYNC=1), loader confirmed it forced enabled
validation.runs: VulkanProbe 12 new sizes at white scale 2, VulkanProbe 12 two-size resizes at the display's white, scratch probe 12 resizes over 4 sizes: 36 purges
validation.positiveControl: present without its wait semaphore and a barrier with srcAccessMask SHADER_READ: 40 messages (VUID-vkCmdPipelineBarrier-pImageMemoryBarriers-02819 x20, VUID-vkQueueSubmit-pSignalSemaphores-00067 x20, SYNC-HAZARD-PRESENT-AFTER-WRITE x10, SYNC-HAZARD-WRITE-AFTER-WRITE x10)

results.test: VulkanProbeTests.AResize_FreesTheHalfFloatOffscreenItReplaces: under 0.1 MB held besides the offscreen in use at each of 10 new sizes; with the purge line removed it fails at 54.8 MB against a 5.0 MB bound
